nodes.description: Address of the HokkBridge contract used as the destination of the cross-chain outboundSwap external call.
Guard flag set while portMessage mints/transfers inbound bridge tokens; read in _transfer to skip the liquidation path.
Guard flag set during swapAndSendToDev so fee logic is not re-applied while the contract swaps its own tokens.
Flag enabling public trading of the token, set once by activate().
Mapping marking addresses as AMM pairs; controls sell/buy fee branches and the liquidation trigger in _transfer.
Mapping of accounts exempt from token transfer fees.

Share of the dev ETH routed to marketingWallet1.
Share of the dev ETH routed to marketingWallet2.
Sum of marketing fees; used as denominator for ETH splits and as fee cap when liquidating.
Array of amount thresholds used to select the applicable buy/sell tax bracket.
Array of sell tax percentages per threshold bracket.
Array of buy tax percentages per threshold bracket.
Fee percentage applied to plain wallet-to-wallet transfers.
Percentage of the contract token balance burned by burnFees().
Destination address for burned tokens.
Uniswap V2 router used for token to ETH swaps.
Uniswap V2 pair of this token; its balance bounds the liquidation amount.
Internal flag toggled by activate().
Wallet set to the owner during initialization and clearable by the owner.
Mapping of dividends already withdrawn per account in the dividend paying token.

Gas forwarded to the ETH transfer inside _withdrawDividendOfUser.
Magnified dividend per share accumulator used for dividend accounting.

Overridden ERC20 transfer that applies dynamic buy/sell/general taxes, triggers burn and liquidation logic.
Private function that swaps contract tokens for ETH and forwards the received ETH to marketing wallets.
Private function performing ETH transfers to marketingWallet1/marketingWallet2.
Private function approving and swapping this token for ETH through the Uniswap V2 router.
Internal function transferring a percentage of the contract balance to burnAddress.
Initializer that sets owner, name/symbol, router, pair, mint and locks the implementation.
onlyOwner function to trigger swapAndSendToDev with an owner supplied token amount.

onlyOwner function enabling trading and contract token swaps.
onlyOwner function registering or removing an AMM pair.
Internal function computing the withdrawable dividend, updating accounting and sending ETH to the user.
onlyOwner function that withdraws dividends for an account, records block.timestamp and emits Claim.
Public entry point allowing a caller to withdraw their own dividend.
Proxiable internal function validating the new implementation and writing its address via inline assembly sstore.
Internal ERC20 mint used by proxyConstructor and portMessage to increase supply and balances.
Public gas-bounded loop that iterates holders and auto-claims dividends for eligible accounts.
Caller controlled address used for burn source, bridge payload sender, bridge authorization and dividend withdrawal.
Block timestamp used for dividend claim timing, auto-claim eligibility and the router swap deadline.

ETH transfer to marketingWallet2 with user/owner controlled destination.

State changing mint performed inside portMessage for a caller supplied recipient amount.
Fee bracket selection and mul/div arithmetic in _transfer including taxThreshold index handling and fee subtraction.
int256 magnified dividend multiplication and correction arithmetic in the dividend paying token accounting.

edges.reason: swapAcrossChain reads bridgePort as the external call target.
bridgePort is the untrusted contract invoked by outboundSwap.
_transfer reads isInPort to skip liquidation when handling inbound bridge tokens.
_transfer reads liquidating to decide whether fees and swaps apply.
activate writes and checks tradingEnabled.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to detect buys/sells and trigger liquidation.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to disable fees for exempt accounts.
sendEthToDev transfers ETH to marketingWallet1.
sendEthToDev transfers ETH to marketingWallet2.
marketingFee1 is the numerator for the marketingWallet1 ETH split.
marketingFee2 is the numerator for the marketingWallet2 ETH split.
totalFees is the denominator of the ETH split in sendEthToDev.
totalFees caps the amount liquidated from the contract balance in _transfer.
_transfer iterates taxThreshold to select the fee bracket index.
_transfer reads sellTaxAmount for the sell fee percentage.
_transfer reads buyTaxAmount for the buy fee percentage.
_transfer uses generalTransferFee for wallet-to-wallet transfers.
burnFees reads burnFeePercentage to size the burn.
burnFees transfers tokens to burnAddress.
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router for the approval and swap.
_transfer reads uniswapV2Pair balance to bound the liquidation amount.
activate sets _swapEnabled to true.
proxyConstructor sets liquidityWallet to the owner.
_withdrawDividendOfUser reads and updates withdrawnDividends for the user.
_withdrawDividendOfUser checks lastClaimTimes indirectly through claim bookkeeping.
gasForTransfer is the gas limit passed to the low level user call.
magnifiedDividendPerShare feeds the accumulative dividend computation.
_transfer invokes burnFees before liquidating.
_transfer invokes swapAndSendToDev when the liquidation conditions hold.
swapAndSendToDev calls swapTokensForEth.
swapAndSendToDev calls sendEthToDev with the ETH gained.
manualSwap calls swapAndSendToDev on owner demand.
updateCode calls updateCodeAddress to write the new implementation.
processAccount calls _withdrawDividendOfUser.
withdrawDividend calls _withdrawDividendOfUser with msg.sender.
process calls processAccount for each eligible holder.
portMessage mints tokens before transferring them to the recipient.
sendEthToDev performs the ETH transfer to marketingWallet1.
sendEthToDev performs the ETH transfer to marketingWallet2.
swapTokensForEth performs the Uniswap router swap call.
_withdrawDividendOfUser sends ETH to an arbitrary user via a low level call.
updateCodeAddress writes the implementation slot with inline assembly sstore.
portMessage mints new tokens for the bridged amount.
_transfer computes fee brackets, multiplications, divisions and subtraction on user controlled amounts.
_withdrawDividendOfUser depends on int256 magnified dividend arithmetic that can overflow corrections.
swapAcrossChain burns from msg.sender and forwards it as the bridge sender.
the onlyBridge modifier authorizes portMessage using msg.sender.
withdrawDividend withdraws the dividend of msg.sender.
processAccount stores block.timestamp as the last claim time.
process relies on block.timestamp based canAutoClaim gating.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
endChain is forwarded to the bridge contract.
preferredNode is forwarded to the bridge contract.
amount controls the burn and bridge payload in swapAcrossChain.
amount is passed as the outboundSwap amount argument.
recipient is forwarded to the bridge.
destination is forwarded to the bridge.
recipient determines who receives tokens in portMessage.
amount determines the minted quantity in portMessage.
amount flows directly into the mint call.
contractTokenBalance caches the contract balance for liquidation decisions.
contractTokenBalance is passed as the swap input amount.
feeIndex selects the tax bracket applied in _transfer.
feeIndex is used to index the buy/sell tax arrays, with an out of range fallback assignment.
fees is subtracted from the transfer amount.
fees is produced by mul/div arithmetic on the transfer amount.
takeFee gates wether the fee branch executes.
initialBalance captures the ETH balance before the swap.
newBalance is derived from initialBalance after the swap.
newBalance is forwarded to sendEthToDev.
tokenAmount is the amount approved and swapped for ETH.
amountToBurn is the quantity transferred to burnAddress.
path is the swap route passed to the router.
from is the debit side of the overridden transfer.
to determines whether sell tax and liquidation logic apply.
amount is the value being transferred and taxed.
amount is used to compute fees.
_lastProcessedIndex tracks loop progress and is persisted at the end.
gasUsed bounds the auto-claim loop.
gasLeft measures per-iteration gas consumption.
iterations counts processed holders.
claims counts successful dividend claims.
account is the holder processed in processAccount.
account is passed to _withdrawDividendOfUser.
automatic is emitted in the Claim event.
the bridge contract can call back into portMessage, which it is the authorized caller of.
the Uniswap router calls back into the token transfer hook during the swap, re-entering _transfer.
the ETH recipient can re-enter the dividend withdrawal path before the state is settled.

normalization_plan.reason: endChain is only used as an argument of swapAcrossChain and carries no independent semantics.
preferredNode is only forwarded by swapAcrossChain and adds no distinct behaviour.
amount directly feeds the untrusted outboundSwap bridge call and should be tracked with it.
recipient is a transient argument of swapAcrossChain.
destination is a transient argument of swapAcrossChain.
recipient is only meaningful inside the portMessage bridge settlement logic.
amount is the exact value used by the mint operation in portMessage.
contractTokenBalance is the input size for the liquidation swap.
feeIndex drives the fee arithmetic and array indexing that constitutes the unsafe operation.
fees is the product of the fee arithmetic in _transfer.
takeFee is a control flag local to _transfer.
initialBalance is a temporary snapshot inside swapAndSendToDev.
newBalance is the ETH amount handed to sendEthToDev.
tokenAmount is the local quantity swapped by swapTokensForEth.
amountToBurn is the local quantity transferred by burnFees.
path is a local routing array for the router swap.
from is a direct argument of the overridden _transfer.
to is a direct argument of the overridden _transfer.
amount is the value mutated and transferred by _transfer.
_lastProcessedIndex is loop bookkeeping local to process().
gasUsed is loop bookkeeping local to process().
gasLeft is loop bookkeeping local to process().
iterations is a return counter of the process loop.
claims is a return counter of the process loop.
account flows straight into the dividend withdrawal call and its bookkeeping.
automatic only affects the Claim event inside processAccount.
